summary.text: Matt Maddock is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 51 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Matt Maddock's general-election opponent is Stacey McDuffie (D).
He owns A-1 Bail Bonds and is Majority Vice Chair of the House Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Matt Maddock lives in Milford, Michigan.
His career experience includes owning A-1 Bail Bonds and working as its president.
He served as president of the Michigan Professional Bail Agents Association and on the board of Citizens for Traditional Values.
Maddock has been assigned to the House Appropriations Committee in each term from 2019-2020 through 2025-2026, and in 2025-2026 he is its Majority Vice Chair.
